Name: Robin new look
Author: pinzol
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]A little update for 1.6. Added a quick edit for Robin's Winter Outfit
[/b][/size][/color][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/133061023-louplex/]Louplex[/url] thanks a lot for reaching me out and updating the code for both versions :)

----------------------------------------------------------


Well now, it's Robin's turn for getting new looks. I personally not so secretly wish Robin was an availible bachelorette, she's so cool!
So, I made a version with her original colours and red hair. And I know, it might be a bit too much of a change for the character, but made a version with purple hair to better match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6375]Maru's new look[/url] mod in the first place. 

[b]Portraits and character sprites, beach included, Emily's 8-heart event sprites included. [color=#ffff00]Use only one version at a time, obviously.
[/color][/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/18314/18314-1694969077-809388644.gif[/img]
